Description: Msg, identified by it's type URL, to grant permissions to the grantee

SpendLimit is the maximum amount of tokens that the grantee can spend on behalf of the granter. If empty, the grantee can only execute messages that do not spend funds (e.g. cancellations). Spending is only metered for messages dispatched through the EVM exchange precompile; any other dispatch path (e.g. MsgExec) is restricted to messages that do not spend funds.
